newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Visiting World Bank experts met heads of both chambers of parliament and Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea and discussed the centrist coalition government's reform programme. The head of the team was quoted as saying that an expert mission would come to Romania in next weeks.

* European Commision top official Jean Trestour is expected to arrive in Bucharest for talks with Romania's new cabinet. Trestour will discuss with Romanian officials progress for Romania's EU integration.

* Romanian and Ukrainian negotiators continued bilateral treaty talks on Tuesday. The main issue of negotiations are the rights over oil-rich deposits offshore the countries' Black Sea coast. Other key issues are the status of Serpent Island and the common border near the mouth of the Danube. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
